lead_raw_text:
The structure of CsBr₃ crystallizes in the cubic space group Pm-3m (No. 221), with a unit cell containing four atoms and two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Br centers with a single Br neighbor at 2.27 Å, while Cs centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with twelve Br neighbors at 3.19 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all four sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Cs-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge sharing between these and the 1-vertex Br polyhedra.
